experiments.scope: The exact sha3-256-r5-prefix-v1 target. The program runs the campaign CAMP of proof.md Section 5 at a reduced budget and does not rerun SEL. Once per run it replays the first block (one five-round call computes N), checks Lemmas 1 and 2 on the embedded chart, computes the certificate of Lemma 3 (the two chi conditions on all six sets), derives the 18 filter planes of Lemma 4a and checks every constant bit of the third-chi quotient, and compares the finite-difference walk of Lemma 4b with the direct filter on 2^12 visits of set 0 (one lane, tables only from the visits of Gray weight at most 8). Each organizer trial is one complete campaign with its own coins (random.Random seeded by the trial seed): six uniform invertible 135 x 135 matrices drawn column by column (at most 128 draws per column) and six translations; the finite-difference visit at reduced width, 2 lanes and 8 blocks per set (the Gray indices 0 to 15, 96 visits), with tables from the direct filter on the down-set and 7 word steps whose operations are counted and asserted; survivors in the scalar visiting order, re-evaluated with the five native rounds, as 176-byte records (digest, fragment, padding), at most 8; the 32-pass byte radix sort on the digest between two arrays; the adjacent scan; native verification of an equal-digest pair. In trials with index divisible by 4 the six translations are replaced by stored survivors of our preregistered sample, so that records, sorting and the scan run on real survivors. Checks beside the algorithm: every visit's planes and verdict against the direct filter, both earlier chi targets at every visit, and every record digest against the complete hash of its message.
experiments.hypothesis: No trial returns a pair: a collision at this budget would need about 2^78 records. The run shows that the shipped program executes the scored algorithm end to end on the target and that its finite-difference filter agrees with the direct filter at every visit. Its 16 untrusted counts per trial satisfy exactly: visits = downset_points = 96; rounds = 3 downset_points + 5 survivors; word_steps = 42; step_ops = 27202 (7 word steps of 3,847 operations and one rebuild of the high table, 273); records = survivors <= 8; radix_passes = 32 if records >= 2 else 0; comparisons = records - 1 (0 if none); verify_calls = 4 per equal-digest pair; planted = 6 in trials with index divisible by 4, else 0; column_draws >= 810; prefix_calls = 1 in trial 0, else 0; invalid = 0; fes_mismatch = 0; record_mismatch = 0. Planted trials have 6 survivors; other trials almost always none (2^-18 per visit). Nothing about cost or the premises is inferred from the run.
